annotations.title: Confirm or ignore a suggested blocker

description: Records the person's answer to a suggested blocker from their own draft. Call it only after asking the person whether the suggestion is a real blocker. Use decision ignored when they say no. When they say yes, add it to the blockers in their own words with its ref; submitting the daily confirms it, and decision confirmed records the answer right away. Calling with decision confirmed is optional, because submitting a daily with a blocker that carries the suggestion's ref confirms it. Never decide on the person's behalf.

decision.description: confirmed when the person said it is a real blocker, ignored when not.

org.description: Organization login. Optional when the person belongs to a single organization.
